exam.question: Exam form कधी भरायचा?
exam.answer: Exam form ची तारीख department किंवा college notice द्वारे जाहीर केली जाते.

exam.question: Exam timetable कुठे मिळेल?
exam.answer: Exam timetable college notice board किंवा official college portal वर उपलब्ध होईल.

scholarship.question: Scholarship साठी कोणते documents लागतात?
scholarship.answer: Scholarship नुसार documents वेगवेगळे असू शकतात. सामान्यतः Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Income Certificate आणि previous marksheet आवश्यक असू शकतात.

scholarship.question: Scholarship form कुठे भरायचा?
scholarship.answer: Scholarship form संबंधित scholarship portal वर online भरावा लागतो.

library.question: Library ची वेळ काय आहे?
library.answer: The college library timing is 7:30 AM to 12:00 PM.

library.question: Library मध्ये किती books issue करता येतात?
library.answer: Books issue करण्याची संख्या college library rules नुसार ठरवली जाते.

admission.question: Admission साठी कोणते documents लागतात?
admission.answer: Admission साठी सामान्यतः marksheet, Aadhaar Card, photographs आणि आवश्यक certificates लागतात.

timetable.question: What is the T.Y. B.Sc. Computer Science timetable?
timetable.answer: The T.Y. B.Sc. Computer Science timetable is effective from 01 July 2026 for Academic Year 2026-27.

timetable.question: What is the Thursday timetable?

timetable.question: What is the Saturday timetable?

timetable.question: When is the Python lecture?
